description: Canonical field registry for person records (SPEC.md §4a, ADR-017). Seeded from the fields the v0 adapters actually touch plus the curated cross-provider overlap. A field name not listed here must be vendor-namespaced (<vendor>.<field>).

fields.name: email
fields.description: Work or personal email. Identity tier 1 (SPEC.md §4).

fields.name: linkedin_url
fields.description: PUBLIC LinkedIn profile URL (vanity slug) only. Identity tier 2 via the derived slug. An internal-form or Sales-Navigator URL is an INVALID value for this field — those are linkedin_internal_url / linkedin_sales_nav_url (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020); the shapes are separate fields precisely so they can never collide under one name.

fields.name: linkedin_internal_url
fields.description: Internal-form LinkedIn profile URL (opaque token in the /in/ path, e.g. linkedin.com/in/ACwAA…). Stored as the URL, case preserved — gtme distinguishes observable URL shapes and does not reinterpret them as identifiers. NOT key material in v0 (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020): an enrichment that resolves it to the public profile writes linkedin_url, and the ordinary key upgrade applies.

fields.name: linkedin_sales_nav_url
fields.description: Sales Navigator URL form (linkedin.com/sales/lead/… or /sales/people/…). Stored as the URL, case preserved. NOT key material in v0 (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020); same recovery path as linkedin_internal_url.

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: Given name. Feeds the name-hash fallback tier with last_name (SPEC.md §4).

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: Family name. Feeds the name-hash fallback tier with first_name (SPEC.md §4).

fields.name: github_username
fields.description: GitHub username. Reserved identity tier 3, key prefix gh: (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020); no v0 adapter provides it.

fields.name: twitter_handle
fields.description: Twitter/X handle without the @. Reserved identity tier 4, key prefix tw: (SPEC.md §4, ADR-020); no v0 adapter provides it.

fields.name: full_name
fields.description: Full display name. Feeds the name-hash fallback tier when first/last are absent.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Current job title, as stated.

fields.name: seniority
fields.description: Seniority band, lowercased. No locked value domain in v0 — providers do not converge enough to pin one; a domain is declared only if real cross-provider evidence shows convergence (SPEC.md §4a).

fields.name: headline
fields.description: Profile headline/tagline.
fields.example: Building outbound that people actually read

fields.name: about
fields.description: Profile summary / about section.

fields.name: city
fields.description: City of residence/work.

fields.name: state
fields.description: State/region.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Free-form location string when a provider does not split city/state/country.

fields.name: company_name
fields.description: Current employer's name.

fields.name: company_domain
fields.description: Current employer's registrable domain (eTLD+1). The comparable, dedupe-safe form — never a full URL.

fields.name: company_website
fields.description: Current employer's website URL as provided. company_domain is the comparable form.

fields.name: company_linkedin_url
fields.description: Current employer's LinkedIn company page URL.

fields.name: company_employees
fields.description: Current employer's headcount as an integer — never a range string. An adapter whose provider reports a range maps it to a point estimate or omits the field.

fields.name: company_industry
fields.description: Current employer's industry label. Value domain deferred until a second adapter forces comparability (rule of two).

fields.name: current_role
fields.description: Current role as an enrichment provider states it (may differ from a source's title).

fields.name: current_company
fields.description: Current employer as an enrichment provider states it.

fields.name: role_history
fields.description: Past roles, most recent first, one string per role.

fields.name: recent_posts
fields.description: Recent public post texts, most recent first.
example: Shipped our new onboarding flow today…

fields.name: follower_count
fields.description: Social follower count.

fields.name: open_to_work
fields.description: Whether the profile advertises being open to work.

fields.name: email_status
fields.description: Email verification status as the providing adapter reports it. Waterfall-relevant; canonical value domain deferred until a second adapter forces comparability (rule of two).

fields.name: first_line
fields.description: Composed personalized opening line, consumed by deliver steps.
fields.example: Loved your post on onboarding flows —

fields.name: ps_line
fields.description: Composed personalized P.S. line, consumed by deliver steps.
fields.example: P.S. congrats on the Series B.
